_comment: Gate questions in English, keyed by the Chinese question text in agent_guidance/tool_table.py + policies.py. tests/test_gate_questions.py fails when a gate question has no English here. Prompts ship as 「中文 / English」 and convert to Traditional through the output-script setting.

questions.要查看全部导出 registry，还是某个技法？: Show the whole export registry, or one technique's?
questions.这段导出正文属于哪个 technique？: Which technique does this export text belong to?
questions.请提供完整星阙 AI 导出正文。: Paste the complete Xingque AI export text.
questions.要看全部知识域，还是只看 astro/liureng/qimen？: All knowledge domains, or only astro / liureng / qimen?
questions.要读哪个知识域？: Which knowledge domain should be read?
questions.请给出分类和 key，例如 planet/日、shen/子、door/休门。: Give the category and key, e.g. planet/日, shen/子, door/休门.
questions.奇门用当前时间还是指定时间？: Cast the Qi Men chart for now or for a specific time?
questions.起盘地点用哪里？: Where should the chart be cast?
questions.这局主要问什么事？: What is this chart mainly asking about?
questions.起局方式？星阙默认为置闰（zhirun）。: Which chart-setting method? Xingque default: zhirun (置闰).
questions.如果是命盘/人事局，请确认性别；纯事件局可沿用默认。: For a natal / personal chart, confirm the gender; a pure event chart can keep the default.
questions.要在哪段时间里找日子？（起止日期）: Which date range should be searched? (start and end dates)
questions.择日要满足什么条件？（如某吉格出现、某门某宫等）: Which conditions must the date meet? (e.g. a given auspicious pattern, a door in a palace)
questions.这次择日是为什么事？（搬家/开业/婚嫁…）: What is the date for? (moving, opening, wedding…)
questions.要在哪段时间里找？（起止日期）: Which date range should be searched? (start and end dates)
questions.择日要满足什么条件？: Which conditions must the date meet?
questions.紫微择时按男命还是女命起盘？（扫描按性别起命盘，影响阴阳局与宫位条件）: Scan as a male or a female chart? (the scan builds a natal chart by gender, changing yin/yang bureau and palace conditions)
questions.要在哪段时间里找吉时？（起止日期）: Which date range should be searched for a good time? (start and end dates)
questions.要满足什么天象条件？（如月亮拱木星、日在白羊等）: Which celestial conditions must hold? (e.g. Moon trine Jupiter, Sun in Aries)
questions.择日地点用哪里？: Where will the event take place?
questions.出生的公历日期和时间？: Gregorian date and time of birth?
questions.大致的出生时间是？（作为扫描锚点）: Approximate birth time? (the anchor of the scan)
questions.扫描半窗多大？: How wide should the scan window be?
questions.有已知人生大事可供参评吗？（可选，录入后事件判据才生效）: Any known life events to test against? (optional; event criteria only apply once entered)
questions.要评估哪个候选时刻？（择日用时，非出生时间）: Which candidate moment should be evaluated? (the moment for the activity, not a birth time)
questions.用事地点用哪里？: Where will the activity take place?
questions.子正用真北还是磁北？: Zi-zheng by true north or magnetic north?
questions.太乙用当前时间还是指定时间？: Cast Tai Yi for now or for a specific time?
questions.是否需要指定性别或太乙参数（盘式/积年/时间基准/流派）？: Specify gender or Tai Yi parameters (layout / accumulated years / time basis / school)?
questions.金口诀地分/方位用哪一支？星阙默认「自动」= 取占时支。: Which branch for the Jin Kou Jue di-fen (direction)? Xingque default 'auto' = the hour branch.
questions.这课主要问什么事？: What is this lesson mainly asking about?
questions.大六壬用当前时间还是指定时间？: Cast Da Liu Ren for now or for a specific time?
questions.起课地点用哪里？: Where should the lesson be cast?
questions.昼夜贵人是否由 Horosa 自动判定？: Let Horosa decide day / night nobles automatically?
questions.起课口径是否沿用星阙默认（正时正将 / 中气过宫 / 晨昏分昼夜 / 涉害仅下贼: Keep the Xingque defaults for the lesson (正时正将 / 中气过宫 / dawn-dusk day-night / 涉害 lower-overcomes-upper only)?
questions.行年需要性别，请选择。: The annual figure needs a gender; please choose.
questions.要看哪一年/哪一段行年？: Which year / span of annual figures?
questions.贵人体系是否沿用星阙默认星占法贵人？: Keep the Xingque default astrological noble?
questions.三式合一用当前时间地点还是指定时间地点？: Use the current time and place for San Shi, or a specific time and place?
questions.这次要三式合参判断什么事？: What should the combined San Shi reading judge?
questions.子技法设置是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for the sub-technique settings?
questions.这卦要问什么事？: What does this hexagram ask about?
questions.所问归哪一类？（决定用神取用）: Which category is the question? (decides the use-god)
questions.断卦流派沿用星阙默认吗？: Keep the Xingque default reading school?
questions.占时用真太阳时还是直接时间？: True solar time or clock time for the casting moment?
questions.统摄法四象参数用默认还是指定？: Default or specified parameters for the four symbols?
questions.请提供出生日期、时间、经度（真太阳时用）和性别。: Give birth date, time, longitude (for true solar time) and gender.
questions.用真太阳时还是钟表时？: True solar time or clock time?
questions.取化工法用哪一档？（只在四立前十八日土用期生人有差）: Which hua-gong level? (only differs for births in the 18 earth days before the four 立 terms)
questions.请提供出生日期、时间和性别（一掌经按农历口径排盘）。: Give birth date, time and gender (Yi Zhang Jing uses the lunar calendar).
questions.定月用农历月还是节气月？: Months by lunar month or by solar-term month?
questions.逐年看小限还是流年十二神？（文献明训两法只用一套；不指定则两法并列）: Read years by minor limits or by the twelve annual spirits? (the texts use one method only; unspecified = both side by side)
questions.请提供出生日期、时间、时区和出生地坐标。: Give birth date, time, time zone and birthplace coordinates.
questions.要查什么？（人物 / 事件关键词 / 术数名 / 天象类别皆可；也可给 acti: What should be looked up? (a person, event keyword, technique name or sky-phenomenon category; or give `action` for a structured view)
questions.四柱干支是什么？（年/月/日/时各一组，如 甲子 丙寅 戊辰 庚申）: What are the four pillars? (one stem-branch pair each for year / month / day / hour, e.g. 甲子 丙寅 戊辰 庚申)
questions.从哪一年开始回推？（缺省=今年）: From which year should the search go back? (default = this year)
questions.要检索哪位名人或哪个关键词？（库内条目以英文为主）: Which celebrity or keyword? (entries are mostly in English)
questions.请提供出生/事件日期、时间、时区和地点。: Give the birth / event date, time, time zone and place.
questions.宿法与人事十二宫起法是否沿用星阙默认？（宿法改二十八宿度数，起法改宫序）: Keep the Xingque defaults for the mansion method and the twelve houses' start? (the method changes mansion degrees, the start changes the house order)
questions.请提供出生/事件的日期、时间、时区和地点。: Give the birth / event date, time, time zone and place.
questions.宫制要用哪一种？（索引见上游表：1 是 Alcabitus，不是 Placidu: Which house system? (see the upstream index: 1 is Alcabitus, not Placidus)
questions.若用恒星黄道，岁差(ayanāṃśa)取哪一制？（仅 zodiacal=1 时生: If sidereal, which ayanamsa? (only with zodiacal=1; default lahiri)
questions.请提供本命出生日期、时间、时区和地点。: Give the natal birth date, time, time zone and place.
questions.推进法/事件/年制/年限是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for progression method / events / year length / span?
questions.是否沿用星阙默认推运设置？: Keep the Xingque default predictive settings?
questions.释放点/算法/年制/年限是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for release point / algorithm / year length / span?
questions.推到哪一天？（targetDate YYYY-MM-DD，可加 targetTi: Progress to which date? (targetDate YYYY-MM-DD, optional targetTime; default = today)
questions.查哪段区间？（startDate/endDate YYYY-MM-DD；缺省=今: Which date range? (startDate / endDate YYYY-MM-DD; default = 90 days from today, max 732 days)
questions.是否列出行运触发本命点的时刻？: List the moments when transits hit natal points?
questions.从哪一年起、列几年？: Start from which year, and how many years?
questions.小推运月长按哪种算？: Which month length for minor progressions?
questions.弧源用哪颗星？（月亮弧=Moon，太阳弧=Sun）: Which body is the arc source? (Moon arc = Moon, solar arc = Sun)
questions.推到哪个目标时刻？（datetime YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss +: Direct to which target moment? (datetime YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss + dirZone)
questions.以哪一天为基准算当前所在阶段？（asOf YYYY-MM-DD，缺省=今天）: As of which date should the current stage be computed? (asOf YYYY-MM-DD; default = today)
questions.起始星/年制/距离口径是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for starting planet / year length / distance basis?
questions.起始星/排序/年制/子限是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for starting planet / order / year length / sub-periods?
questions.三分体系/划分法/寿命基准是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for triplicity scheme / division / longevity basis?
questions.日月返照年表从哪一年起、算几年？: From which year should the solar / lunar return table start, and for how many years?
questions.请提供「提问当下」的日期、时间、时区和地点（卜卦以提问时刻起盘，不是出生时间）。: Give the date, time, time zone and place of the moment the question is asked (horary uses the question moment, not a birth time).
questions.问的是哪一类事？: Which kind of matter is asked about?
questions.卜卦按哪一派判？（流派同时决定宫制、界系、三分集等起盘口径）: Which horary school? (the school also sets house system, terms and triplicities)
questions.请提供要评估的候选日期、时间、时区和举事地点。: Give the candidate date, time, time zone and place of the activity.
questions.请提供起卦的日期、时间、时区和地点（地占以起卦时刻确定性起卦）。: Give the date, time, time zone and place of the casting (geomancy casts deterministically from that moment).
questions.所问何事？请给出具体问题。: What is the question? Please state it concretely.
questions.请提供起卦的日期与时间（塔罗以起卦时刻确定性抽牌）。也可直接给 seed。: Give the date and time of the draw (tarot draws deterministically from that moment), or give a seed.
questions.想问什么？请给出具体问题。: What do you want to ask? Please state it concretely.
questions.请提供起卦的日期与时间（灵棋经以起卦时刻确定性掷棋）。: Give the date and time of the casting (Lingqi casts deterministically from that moment).
questions.属于哪一类问事？（只影响问类标注，不改卦）: Which category is the question? (only labels it; does not change the cast)
questions.如何起课？给三个数 nums=[月,日,时]，或提供起课的日期/时间（按占时以农: How should it be cast? Give three numbers nums=[month, day, hour], or the date / time of the casting (by the lunar month / day / hour branch).
questions.如何起局？给起支（时支/选支/数取/年支），或提供起局的日期/时间（按占时以时支: How should it be cast? Give the starting branch (hour / chosen / number / year), or the date / time of the casting (by the hour branch).
questions.日干支是什么？（主=日干、客=日支落宫）。占时可由起局时刻自动取。: What are the day stem and branch? (host = day stem, guest = day-branch palace); the casting moment can supply them.
questions.请给该起卦法所需的输入（手动=上下卦、两数=两数、股价=开收价、大衍=种子/蓍草: Give the input for that casting method (manual = upper / lower trigram, two numbers, stock open / close, da yan seed / stalks, moment = date and time).
questions.请给该起卦法所需的输入，并给起卦的日期/时间（元会运世、时方需四柱）。: Give the input for that casting method and the date / time of the casting (yuan-hui-yun-shi and shi-fang need the four pillars).
questions.请提供出生的日期、时间、时区（+经度）与性别（铁算心易查询层除外）。: Give birth date, time, time zone (+ longitude) and gender (except the 铁算心易 lookup layer).
questions.流派专属：邵子的父母年龄/元(上中下)、大定的所推流年、六亲的演算时辰/环境。: School-specific: parents' ages / era for Shao Zi, the annual year for Da Ding, the hour / setting for Liu Qin.
questions.请提供起盘的公历日期（年月日）。: Give the Gregorian date of the chart (year, month, day).
questions.几点起盘？（可选；影响时柱，留空按 00:00 起）: At what time? (optional; changes the hour pillar; empty = 00:00)
questions.出生/起盘地的时区？（年柱月柱按时区定立春与节气）: Time zone of the birth / chart place? (year and month pillars depend on the zone for Li Chun and the solar terms)
questions.性别？（条文按男女分列）: Gender? (the texts are split by male / female)
questions.起盘地点（经纬度或城市）与时区？: Place of the chart (coordinates or city) and time zone?
questions.观测地点的经纬度与时区？（通常用首都/关切地）: Coordinates and time zone of the observation place? (usually the capital or the place of concern)
questions.要择的是哪一天？（公历 YYYY-MM-DD）: Which day is being chosen? (Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD)
questions.用哪一派通书？（同一天在不同流派下结论可以完全相反，必须指定）: Which tongshu school? (the same day can get opposite verdicts in different schools, so it must be named)
questions.要择的用事是什么？（嫁娶 / 开市 / 安葬 / 动土 …）: What activity is it for? (wedding / opening / burial / ground-breaking …)
questions.请提供出生日期、时间、时区和地点。: Give birth date, time, time zone and place.
questions.实位派系与分至规范取哪一套？（派系改「位」的落点、分至规范改春分度数）: Which school of positions and which equinox convention? (the school moves the positions, the convention the equinox degree)
questions.请提供出生日期、时间、时区和出生地点。: Give birth date, time, time zone and birthplace.
questions.重置到哪个地点？（迁居/旅居地的经纬度，如伦敦 51n30 / 0w07）: Relocate to which place? (coordinates of the new home or stay, e.g. London 51n30 / 0w07)
questions.分宫制取哪一种？（共 24 制，缺省整宫/Rashi）: Which house system? (24 available; default whole-sign / Rashi)
questions.请分别提供双方出生日期、时间、时区和地点。: Give both people's birth date, time, time zone and place.
questions.要推哪一年/哪一天/哪个事件时间？: Which year / date / event time should be forecast?
questions.十年大运算法设置是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for the decennials algorithm?
questions.这次占问的问题是什么？: What is the question for this reading?
questions.骰子结果由用户指定还是需要随机/默认？: Are the dice results given by the user, or random / default?
questions.紫微需要性别，请选择。: Zi Wei needs a gender; please choose.
questions.子时换日、晚子时时柱和时间算法是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for the day change at zi hour, the late-zi hour pillar and the time algorithm?
questions.四化流派与传本设置（大限跨度/天马/星集/三盘/闰月/晚子时/定年界线/火铃/亮: Keep the Xingque defaults for the si hua school and edition settings (decade span / Tian Ma / star set / three charts / leap month / late zi / year boundary / Huo Ling / brightness…)?
questions.真太阳时、子时换日、晚子时时柱是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for true solar time, the day change at zi hour and the late-zi hour pillar?
questions.神煞主位、命宫起法、断命流派是否沿用星阙默认？: Keep the Xingque defaults for the shen sha anchor, the life-palace method and the reading school?
questions.出生地在南半球：月令是否对冲？（只对南纬生效；星阙默认不对冲，月柱同北半球）: Born in the southern hemisphere: reverse the month order? (southern latitudes only; Xingque default: no reversal, same month pillar as the north)
questions.排大运需要性别，请选择。: The decade luck needs a gender; please choose.
questions.要全部节气还是指定节气？: All solar terms or selected ones?
questions.请提供要换算的日期、时间和时区。: Give the date, time and time zone to convert.
questions.请提供经度；如需真太阳时也请提供纬度。: Give the longitude; for true solar time also the latitude.
questions.子时换日、晚子时时柱和时间算法是否沿用默认？: Keep the defaults for the day change at zi hour, the late-zi hour pillar and the time algorithm?
questions.要查询哪个月份的黄历？请给出该月内任一公历日期。: Which month's calendar? Give any Gregorian date in that month.
questions.历算经度沿用东经120度标准，还是指定当地经度？: Keep the standard 120°E longitude for the calendar, or use the local longitude?
questions.要查询哪些卦名？请给出一个或多个卦名。: Which hexagram names? Give one or more names.
questions.性别？（男命 / 女命取法不同）: Gender? (male and female charts are read differently)
